issues.reason: "in comedic roles" answers neither where / when / how nor a direct-object slot, and a prepositional verb's object goes in the preposition-named oblique, so (Location sk_appear_2 comedic_role) asserts a spatial position of an abstract role that the text never states.

Same verb, same preposition, same head: a film is a medium, not a place ("on the mural is not a Location — they are not standing on it"), so (Location sk_appear_1 music_film) over-asserts a spatial reading of the coordinated first conjunct too.

"later" states an explicit sequence between the two appearing events, and Time makes (Before <earlier> <later>) the canonical relation for exactly that — the same atom the "next / following" sequence rule emits — so the ordering is stated content dropped with a licensed form available.

gaps_confirmed: life-stage temporal adjunct "later in life" — no licensed Time filler family (structured calendar terms, speech-anchored deictics, day-parts) covers it, so the constant later_in_life is coined
repair_summary: Re-headed both appear-in obliques from Location to the surface preposition In (statements 3 and 9); appended (Before sk_appear_1 sk_appear_2) for the ordering "later" states. Proof names, symbols, fillers and all other atoms unchanged.
notes: The second reviewer gap is not confirmed: the preposition-named oblique is the instruction set's stated catch-all for a PP fitting no named role, so "appear in <film / role>" does have a licensed encoding. The coined later_in_life is left standing — it is true of the sentence and well-typed, and no confirmed issue names it.
